instruction: Choose exactly one allowed action. Use only supplied observations and retrieved knowledge. Do not calculate or set emotion.

latestAttribution.cause: Explicitly equipping the legendary legs on the warrior raised visible equipped power by 90.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge the high-health bear with the strengthened output roster; only seek the optional sustained-damage ranger if direct damage fails or stalls.

latestAttribution.cause: The strengthened berserker became damage rank one at 41.65% and scored multiple visible kills, letting the all-damage roster clear the heavy-shield encounter without the optional armory.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Continue the main route with the current damage core; reconsider the optional armory only if a later shielded fight produces a loss or severe slowdown.

latestAttribution.cause: The armed mage remained damage rank one at 37.35%, while the armed warrior rose to rank two; the damage-focused weapon investment preserved the fast clear.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Continue to the newly opened main encounter with the same damage core and use the first loss or ally death as evidence that more sustain is needed.

latestAttribution.cause: The full warrior again ranked first and supplied 53.94% of team damage, confirming it as the stable direct-damage lead in the new encounter.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Test the newly unlocked full mage in place of the lowest observed damage contributor while retaining the proven warrior damage lead.

latestAttribution.cause: Explicitly replacing the mage's common weapon with the rare fire-amplifying weapon raised visible equipped power by 25.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip the high-fit legendary leg armor on the warrior, then test whether the current output core can defeat the visible high-health target without rescuing the optional ranger.

latestAttribution.cause: Explicitly equipping the epic boots on the proven berserker raised visible equipped power by 56.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge the next main encounter and see whether the strengthened all-damage team still clears without an ally death.

latestAttribution.cause: Explicitly equipping the physical-power gloves on the warrior raised visible equipped power by 48.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip the high-fit epic boots on the berserker, then test the strengthened damage roster in the next main encounter.

hypotheses.problem: The team must keep enough damage while advancing into a new encounter.
hypotheses.cause: The full warrior's observed rank-one direct damage is the team's main clearing engine.

hypotheses.problem: The team contains a repeatedly weak damage contributor before the next main encounter.
hypotheses.cause: The barricade militia contributes little direct damage while the full mage is presented as an output specialist.

hypotheses.problem: The active team still contains a very low-damage healing slot before an encounter with enemy healing.
hypotheses.cause: A high-risk full output hero should add more direct pressure than the low-output herb militia.
